title: Identity Platform — implementation
summary: Introduce authentication and user ownership through a provider-agnostic abstraction, with local auth (registration, login/logout, password reset/change, profile) as the first concrete backend. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: Auth is accessed only through the provider abstraction (no direct coupling)
A user can register, log in, log out, reset and change password
A user can view and edit their profile
Saved models are correctly associated with their owner
Passwords are stored hashed; sessions handled securely
notes:
Scope (in): Auth abstraction layer (provider interface); Local authentication: registration, login, logout; Password reset and change; Profile management; Association of saved models with an owning user
Out of scope: External OIDC/social providers (future stories); Sharing/visibility rules (EPIC-006); Encrypted per-user AI keys (EPIC-009)
